SREEKANTH ELAYIDATH

+91 - 9447170088

Mail-maalusree@gmail.com

Results-driven Senior Project Management professional with 15 years of experience delivering large-scale Banking, BFSI, FinTech, Healthcare, and Media technology programs across Agile and Waterfall environments. Targeting Project Manager / Senior Project Manager / Agile Delivery leadership opportunities, leveraging expertise in Agile transformation, stakeholder management, release governance, cross-functional leadership, and enterprise-scale delivery management.

Core Competencies

Profile Summary

Strategic Project Delivery

Regulatory Compliance

Providing strategic leadership for delivery governance and release management across Commonwealth Bank of Australia (CBA) engagements, enabling enterprise transformation, governance excellence, risk-controlled deployments, and alignment with business and regulatory objectives.

Risk Mitigation Strategies

Agile Methodology Implementation Stakeholder Relationship Management

Process Optimization Techniques

Successfully led multiple high-impact Banking and Regulatory Transformation initiatives including ECDD & UMR AML Workflow Automation, PowerApps Modernization, FinTech Credit Risk Programs, Client Onboarding Platforms, Settlements Systems, and Contract Management Solutions for global clients including CBA, Société Générale, NBCU, and Hershey’s. Recognized for delivering complex Enterprise Programs within strict timelines, quality benchmarks, and compliance standards by optimizing Agile Delivery Frameworks, streamlining Onboarding & Release Processes, improving Sprint Velocity through Data-Driven Planning, and managing large Cross-Functional Teams across distributed delivery models.

Performance Improvement Initiatives

Change Management Processes

Team Development and Training

Financial Services Operations

Core expertise in Strategic Project Delivery, Agile Transformation, Release & Delivery Management, Stakeholder Management, Regulatory & Compliance Systems, Risk Mitigation, Capacity Planning, Scrum Governance, Production Deployment, Banking Operations, and Cross-Functional Team Leadership.

Technically proficient in Jira, ServiceNow, Confluence, SDLC Hub, Power Builder & Oracle, while having managerial experience with PowerApps, Angular, Java, PostgreSQL, Apache Flink, Amazon Bedrock, IAM/SSO Integrations, BDD/TDD Frameworks, and Enterprise Application Modernization.

Education

Master of Computer Applications (MCA) IGNOU University | 2003

Certified Scrum Alliance Certified Scrum Master (CSM) and ICAgile Certified Professional in Agile Coaching (ICP-ACC) with strong Leadership, Stakeholder Communication, Conflict Resolution, Mentoring, and Team-Building capabilities, enabling successful delivery of large-scale transformation programs in highly regulated enterprise environments.

Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) Mahatma Gandhi University | 1999

Technical Skills

Project & Delivery Tools: Jira, ServiceNow, Confluence, SDLC Hub, Power Builder, Oracle

Agile & Delivery Methodologies: Agile Scrum Framework, Waterfall Methodology, Sprint &

Backlog Management, Release Management, Production Release Governance

Certifications

ICAgile Certified Professional in Agile Coaching (ICP-ACC)

Managerial Skills

Scrum Alliance Certified Scrum

Development & Technologies: Angular, Java, PostgreSQL, Apache Flink, PowerBuilder, Oracle,

Master (CSM)

PowerApps

Cloud & AI Technologies: Agentic AI Integration

Personal Details

Infrastructure & Security: Identity & Access Management (IAM), Single Sign-On (SSO), Firewall & Server Infrastructure Coordination

Current Location: Ernakulam Date of Birth: 25 May 1979 Languages Known: English, Malayalam, Hindi, Tamil

Testing & Quality Engineering: Capacity & Performance Testing (NFT)

Enterprise Platforms & Modernization: Mainframe Modernization, Re-platforming & Application

Modernization, CI/CD & Production Deployment Coordination

Banking & Financial Systems: KYC & AML Workflow Systems, Referential Data Systems, Contract

& Settlement Systems, Automated Workflow Systems

Work Experience

September 2016 – Present Senior Project Manager | HCL Technologies Commonwealth Bank of Australia (CBA) | Aug 2019 – Present Role: Release Manager / Project Manager | Team Size: 32–54

Managed end-to-end resource fulfillment activities including demand planning, resource onboarding, workforce deployment,

capacity management, budget tracking, and project staffing coordination for large-scale banking transformation programs.

Architected release governance frameworks and deployment processes for enterprise workflow systems processing 7,000+ daily transactions, ensuring compliance-driven production readiness.

Orchestrated delivery across 10–12 cross-functional squads spanning GenAI, PowerApps, CommSec, EDA, and Trade Finance streams

while managing stakeholder alignment, infrastructure readiness, and NFT coordination.

Governed enterprise-scale production implementations including ECDD & UMR AML workflow modernization, SSO integrations,

SDLC Hub change approvals, and seamless L2/L3 operational transition activities.

NBCU – Compass Re-platform (Schedules) | Sep 2017 – Jul 2019 Role: Scrum Master / Project Manager | Team Size: 30

Spearheaded modernization of a legacy client-server platform into a scalable Angular/Java multi-tier architecture, driving enterprise

application re-platforming initiatives.

Enhanced Agile delivery efficiency through data-driven sprint planning, backlog prioritization, and issue governance, improving

overall sprint predictability and execution quality.

Thryve Digital – Product, Sales, Client, Services (PSCS) | Sep 2016 – Aug 2017 Role: Technical Manager | Team Size: 23

Led technical delivery, code governance, and application modernization initiatives for healthcare partner platforms supporting

business scalability and operational continuity. Instituted structured risk mitigation, capacity planning, and skills matrix frameworks to strengthen delivery readiness, capability development, and engineering productivity.

August 2015 – March 2016 Project Manager | KBridge Solutions (Client: Infosys – Hershey’s Account)

Facilitated Agile delivery and sprint governance activities for Product Change Management initiatives, optimizing sprint velocity

through collaborative capacity planning and execution tracking. Implemented issue management and escalation frameworks to proactively identify delivery bottlenecks, minimizing project delays and improving workflow transparency.

Coordinated with business and technical stakeholders to manage complex master data, financial change requests, and cross-

functional delivery dependencies.

May 2010 – August 2015 Technical Manager / Scrum Master / Agile Delivery Lead | Société Générale Global Solution Centre

Directed cross-functional onsite/offshore engineering teams delivering critical banking applications, regulatory workflow systems,

settlements platforms, and reference data solutions across Front, Middle, and Back Office operations.

Facilitated Agile transformation initiatives across multiple Scrum teams supporting TPS and SCOW platforms, driving Sprint

Planning, Retrospectives, backlog governance, and Scrum-of-Scrums coordination.

Monitored sprint health, burn-down metrics, and delivery velocity through VersionOne while coaching teams and stakeholders on

Agile best practices and backlog optimization strategies.

Executed end-to-end delivery management for Settlements-SSI programs, managing project planning, regulatory timelines, risk

mitigation strategies, and capacity optimization initiatives.

Championed KYC compliance and onboarding workflow modernization by deploying the SCOW platform integrating regulatory

verification controls, customer onboarding checkpoints, and referential data governance.

Strengthened operational efficiency by establishing technical capability matrices, removing delivery impediments, governing

contract and settlement data mapping activities, and ensuring seamless feature integration across dependent systems.

Previous Experience

August 2008 – May 2010 Technical Lead | PSI Data Systems (Client: Société Générale)

November 2007 – August 2008 Senior Software Engineer | iGATE Global

June 2001 – November 2007 Senior Programmer | Cochin Computing Studio & Research Centre
